title: The Nanny Chronicles: Tommy's Milestones
content: Today, Tommy managed to tie his shoes all by himself for the first time! It was a moment of pure joy and a big milestone for him. We celebrated with his favorite chocolate chip cookies.

title: The Nanny Chronicles: Daily Schedule
content: Tommy's schedule: 3 PM - Pick up from school, 3:30 PM - Snack time at the park, 4 PM - Homework, 5 PM - Playtime at the local playground, 6 PM - Dinner preparation.
